## Comparison of soil physicochemical properties between irrigated and non-irrigated fields

## Load packages and functions

```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Import dataset

```{r}
metadata1 <- read.csv("Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
# choose irrigated and non-irrigated fields
metadata1 <- subset(metadata1, Irrigation %in% c("irrigated","non-irrigated"))
env1 <- read.csv("Vetted_soil_properties.csv", row.names = 1, header = T)
metadata <- metadata1[rownames(metadata1) %in% rownames(env),]
env2 <- otutab1[rownames(metadata),]
env <- cbind(metadata, env2)
```


# set up plot parameters

```{r}
theme.plot <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 19, colour = "black"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 19, colour = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
  legend.position = "none")
```

## Plot
```{r}
# Surface moisture
range(env$SM.M10)
tapply(env$SM.M10, env$Irrigation, mean)
p1 <- ggplot(data = env, aes(x = Irrigation, y = SM.M10, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.17, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(data= env, aes(x=Irrigation, y=SM.M10), color= "black", size=1.5, height=0.02, width=0.1, alpha= 0.6) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4169B2", "#BB2BA0","gray")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Suface moisture (m3/m3)") + 
  theme.plot + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.13, 0.365)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.36, label = "P = 0.012", size = 6)

p1
anova(lmer(SM.M10 ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
ggsave("Surface moisture.pdf", p1, width = 5, height = 5.5)


# Silt content
range(env$Silt)
tapply(env$Silt, env$Irrigation, mean) # irr, 37.4;  unirr, 42.6
p2 <- ggplot(data = env, aes(x = Irrigation, y = Silt, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.17, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(data=env, aes(x=Irrigation, y= Silt, fill=Irrigation), size=1.5, height=0.02, width=0.1, alpha= 0.6) +

  labs(y = "Silt (%)", x = "") + ylim(0, 85) +
  theme.plot + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(13, 86)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 85, label = "P = 0.005", size = 6)

p2
anova(lmer(Silt ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
ggsave("Silt.pdf", p2, width = 5, height = 5.5)

# Microbial biomass
env.bio <- env %>% filter(!is.na(Biomass)) # There are four NA values needed to be removed
range(env$Biomass)
which(env$Biomass > 485) # check and remove outlier which is extremely high
env.b <- env.bio[-41,]
tapply(env.b$Biomass, env.b$Irrigation, mean)
p22 <- ggplot(data = env, aes(x = Irrigation, y = Biomass, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.1, alpha= 0.7) +  
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.17, fill= "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4169B2",  "#BB2BA0")) +  
  labs(y = "Microbial biomass (μg C g-1 soil)", x = "") + 
  theme.plot +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 485), breaks = seq(0, 510, 100)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 480, label = "P = 0.401", size = 6)

p22
anova(lmer(Biomass ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env.b))
ggsave("Microbial biomass.pdf", p22, width = 5, height = 5.5)
```
